pipeline_metadata.name: Universal Hybrid AI Filmmaking Pipeline (3D Previs + Neural Diffusion)
pipeline_metadata.architecture: Engine-Agnostic / Multi-Modal Video-to-Video Synthesis / 3D Layout Driven
pipeline_metadata.description: Exhaustive, production-grade technical specification and execution framework for narrative and animated filmmaking fusing 3D layout, locked 2D reference sheets, 5-block prompt hierarchies, lipsync, depth compositing, and editorial conforming.

core_axioms.name: Asset-First Foundation
core_axioms.rule: Output quality is strictly bound to input reference quality. Never generate video before character, prop, and environment reference sheets are fully locked and approved.

core_axioms.name: 3D Functional Separation
core_axioms.rule: 3D software provides camera vectors, velocity, physical timing, and collision tracking only. It must never provide beauty shading or final textures.

core_axioms.name: Texture Decoupling
core_axioms.rule: Dense procedural or painterly textures applied directly to moving 3D geometry cause temporal tracking collapse. Moving entities must retain clean volumetric surfaces; heavy painterly styles remain isolated to static background plates.

core_axioms.name: Pre-Production Stress Testing
core_axioms.rule: Run an end-to-end generation pass on the single most complex hero action shot to isolate lighting, drift, and topology errors before full-scale rollout.

core_axioms.name: VFX & Facial Decoupling
core_axioms.rule: Never generate chaotic environmental VFX (smoke, debris, rain) or articulative dialogue directly over dynamic character takes. Generate clean plates and composite in layers.

criteria: Dynamic camera trajectories (dolly, crane, tracking, orbit, dutch tilt)
Direct physical contact or mechanical interlocking between entities/objects
Precision kinetic timing where split-second delays alter comedic or dramatic impact
Complex spatial navigation through tight architecture or vehicle interiors
type_a_previs_mandatory.workflow: 3D Layout -> Neutral Viewport Clay Pass -> Multi-Reference Video Diffusion

criteria: Static dialogue setups and conversation reverse shots
Wide scenic establishing shots with minimal focal movement

phase_1_asset_engineering.llm_system_prompt_for_assets: You are a Technical Art Director for cinematic film production utilizing an AI diffusion pipeline. Convert short concept descriptions into deterministic prompts for image diffusion models. Requirements: 1. Model turnaround sheets for characters (front, 3/4, profile, back) in a single frame; multi-angle sheets for props; panoramic plates for environments. 2. Clean volumetric geometry, distinct silhouettes, no micro-surface noise. 3. Characters/props isolated on flat neutral grey (#808080) or pure white with subtle ground ambient occlusion only. 4. Structure: [SUBJECT], [VIEWS/ANGLES], [WARDROBE/ACCENTS], [LIGHTING/FINISH], [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS]. Respond solely with the final prompt in English.

prompt_templates.entity_turnaround: Model turnaround sheet of [ENTITY_ARCHETYPE], [VISUAL_ART_STYLE]. Four consistent full-body angles horizontally in one frame: direct front view, three-quarter front view, profile side view, three-quarter back view. Two isolated facial expression callouts in upper corner. Anatomy and silhouette: [PHYSICAL_PROPORTIONS, BUILD, POSTURE]. Costume/Equipment: [UPPER_SURFACE], [LOWER_SURFACE], [ACCESSORIES]. Clean structural contrast between skin/garments. Neutral studio three-point lighting, balanced ambient occlusion, zero dramatic shadows. Pure flat neutral light grey background (#D6D6D6), completely isolated asset turnaround sheet, zero environmental elements, production-ready reference.
prompt_templates.hero_prop_turnaround: Hero prop turnaround concept sheet of [PROP_DEVICE_ARCHETYPE], [VISUAL_ART_STYLE]. Cleanly arranged: 3/4 perspective view, direct side elevation, direct front view, top-down view. Visual attributes: [FORM_LANGUAGE], [PRIMARY_MATERIAL: matte wood, polished metal, worn stone], subtle functional accents, clean edge definition. Studio key and fill lighting, minimal specular glare, subtle contact shadow beneath base. Solid clean white background (#FFFFFF), perfectly isolated, no environment, no hands holding object, master design reference.
prompt_templates.environment_plate: Cinematic wide establishing background plate of [LOCATION_SETTING], [VISUAL_ART_STYLE]. Ultra-wide 16:9 cinematic vista, clear foreground, midground, background separation, strong atmospheric depth, distinct horizon. Lighting: [DIRECTIONAL_LIGHTING_FORMULA: e.g., low directional golden hour sun at 45 degrees, casting long harsh dynamic shadows across surfaces], atmospheric haze layers, strong volumetric depth. Empty scene, zero dynamic entities, zero moving foreground objects, clean environment plate ready for staging.

post_processing_2d_pass.step_1_value_chroma: Curves adjustment: crush blacks by 4%, lift highlights by 2%. Boost Vibrance +15% to +25%, Saturation +10%.
post_processing_2d_pass.step_2_silhouette_inking: Hard textured brush (3-5px, 100% opacity). Manually draw outer contour lines along hair, collars, and silhouette boundaries to prevent temporal edge melting.
post_processing_2d_pass.step_3_contact_shadow: Soft round brush (Multiply, 30-40% opacity). Paint dark ambient occlusion directly beneath contact boundaries.
post_processing_2d_pass.step_4_locking: Export as 16-bit uncompressed PNG. Save as [PROJECT]_[ASSET]_[VERSION]_LOCKED.PNG. Immutable reference.

viewport_shading.material: Clay / Single Color MatCap (50% neutral studio grey). Zero diffuse textures, zero color maps.
viewport_shading.specular: 0% (Disable completely to prevent AI from hallucinating wet, chrome, or latex surfaces on skin and matte clothing).
viewport_shading.shadows: Screen Space Ambient Occlusion (SSAO) and ground contact shadows MUST be enabled.
viewport_shading.motion_blur: Disabled completely (prevents blurry edge tracking failures).

focal_length_matrix.kinetic_action_chase: 18mm - 24mm (Wide angle; exaggerates radial perspective and velocity parallax)
focal_length_matrix.disorientation_impact: 18mm - 28mm (Dutch angle tilted 25 degrees with vertical pedestal shift)

camera_rules.camera_distance_rule: Zoom out. Keep sufficient negative space and horizon visibility around proxy meshes. If an untextured clay mesh fills the frame, the model treats it as abstract geometry and hallucinates.
camera_rules.depth_of_field_in_previs: Disabled (Deep focus only). Render full depth sharpness in 3D; control background blur purely via text prompt.

spatial_choreography.mesh_collision_rule: Zero mesh interpenetration. Maintain a mandatory 1cm air gap between touching 3D geometries to prevent limbs and objects from fusing into mutated anatomy.
spatial_choreography.exaggeration: Animate physical deformation (squash & stretch, anticipation) with 15% to 20% more intensity than reality to offset neural smoothing.
spatial_choreography.framerate_and_cuts: 24.000 fps continuous export. Never include hard cuts inside a single previs clip. 1 cut = 1 independent generation pass.

phase_3_neural_synthesis.prompt_hierarchy_rule: The first 20% of the prompt governs ~80% of model attention. Visual identity must be bound to images, not text.
phase_3_neural_synthesis.consistency_anchor: Characters, environments, and props 100% strictly match reference images.

block_1_context_cinematography.contents: 1-2 sentences defining genre, environment, world physics, specific lens, camera motion vector, and lighting formula.

block_2_active_references_binding.contents: Explicit mapping of inputs. Assign Ref Video as motion/camera guide only (ignore clay shading). Map Ref Images to specific entities by ID/color tier. Include consistency anchor and positional locks.

block_3_action_beats_timing.contents: Second-by-second chronological choreography (0.0s-1.2s start, 1.2s-2.5s apex/contact, 2.5s-4.0s recovery/settle).

block_4_locks_constraints.contents: Mandatory negatives: 'SFX only, no background music', 'no morphing geometry', 'no extra limbs', 'no unprompted camera pans', 'no random internal cuts'.

block_5_animation_physics.contents: Physical weight instructions: visible muscle tension, inertia, squash and stretch, mass distribution, clear follow-through.

module_01_lip_sync_and_facial_performanc.problem: Video diffusion models struggle to generate synchronized, articulate phonemes for dialogue over multi-second takes.
module_01_lip_sync_and_facial_performanc.pipeline_rule: Decouple head motion from speech synthesis.
workflow_steps: 1. Lock performance take with closed or neutral mouth movement.
2. Record or generate finalized clean audio voice track (ADR).
3. Route the locked video pass and isolated audio track into a dedicated neural lipsync model (e.g., LivePortrait, SadTalker, SyncTalk, or equivalent).
4. Inpaint lips and lower jaw area only, blending with original facial skin texture to preserve global head motion and lighting.

module_02_deterministic_camera_matchmove.problem: Visual video-to-video tracking occasionally drifts by 2-5% in focal length or perspective.
module_02_deterministic_camera_matchmove.solution: Depth and Optical Flow conditioning (ControlNet / Advanced Pipeline).

execution.pass_01: Export Camera Trajectory alongside Depth Map Pass (Z-Depth / MiDaS format) from 3D software.
execution.pass_02: Export Normal Map Pass (surface angles) from 3D viewport.
execution.pass_03: Feed Depth + Normal passes as secondary structural control layers into the diffusion engine to mathematically clamp perspective distortion to zero.

module_03_multi_angle_scene_coverage_con.problem: Cutting between Shot A (Wide) and Shot B (Reverse Over-The-Shoulder) causes micro-shifts in costumes, hair parts, or prop locations.
continuity_locks: Use precise spatial coordinate logs: note which hand holds the prop, hair parting direction (left/right), and asymmetric markings.
Render the 3D Previs for BOTH angles from the exact same animated 3D master scene (simply switch cameras in Blender).
Seed-Locking: Use fixed seed ranges and identical Image Reference Sheets across both angles.
Prompt Anchor: Explicitly state orientation in Block 1: 'Camera positioned over right shoulder of Entity B, facing Entity A directly; prop remains in Entity A's left hand.'

module_04_vfx_depth_and_layer_compositin.problem: Attempting to generate rain, explosions, fire, or dust directly within the character video take often distorts character faces.
module_04_vfx_depth_and_layer_compositin.vfx_separation_rule: Never prompt heavy particle VFX over actor faces.
workflow: 1. Generate clean character performance shot without environmental chaos.
2. Generate or composite VFX (smoke, debris, muzzle flashes, rain) as separate alpha layers.
3. Extract AI depth map (Z-depth) from the rendered character take.
4. Sandwich VFX layers in 2.5D space in After Effects or DaVinci Fusion: Background -> Ambient Dust -> Character -> Foreground Debris.

editorial_conforming.retiming_performance_gap: When subtle emotional reactions or pauses collapse, cut the frame at the micro-reaction and apply Optical Flow speed ramping (120%-150% stretch) to restore timing.

continuity_and_color.anchor_frame_protocol: Export final frame of Shot N (16-bit PNG) and inject as Frame 0 (Starting Frame) of Shot N+1 for spatial continuity.
continuity_and_color.cross_environment_relighting: Pre-grade character asset sheets with an environment-specific LUT/gradient map before feeding into a new lighting context.
continuity_and_color.unification: Apply ACEScc/DaVinci YRGB management, balance using gray card reference, apply global show LUT, and overlay unified 35mm film grain (0.25-0.35 strength) to blend 2D, 3D, and AI layers.

audio_stem_mastering.stem_a_dialogue: Isolated voice tracks, ADR, breath passes.
audio_stem_mastering.stem_b_sfx_foley: Surface friction, footsteps, mechanical impacts, room tone.
audio_stem_mastering.stem_c_music: Dedicated score composed directly to the locked edit.

troubleshooting_matrix.root_cause: Empty seats or void spaces in the 3D previs prompt the AI to fill the negative space.
troubleshooting_matrix.remedy: Insert basic low-poly proxy volumes into empty zones. In Block 4 add: 'Space occupied strictly by designated subjects only.'

troubleshooting_matrix.root_cause: Previs geometry is too dense or high-poly; the model prioritizes 3D wireframe over image references.
troubleshooting_matrix.remedy: Simplify previs meshes to smooth, subdivided low-poly proxy shapes. Move reference binding block into the top 20% of the prompt.

troubleshooting_matrix.root_cause: Text prompt contains conflicting spatial terms with the 3D camera trajectory.
troubleshooting_matrix.remedy: Capture the best framing frame from a successful take and supply it as an explicit first-frame image input.

troubleshooting_matrix.root_cause: The camera framing reference or intermediate screenshot omitted the detail.
troubleshooting_matrix.remedy: Open the framing reference in 2D software, manually paint or composite the missing accessory back in, and re-upload.

troubleshooting_matrix.symptom: Performance gap (subtle acting collapses during stunts)
troubleshooting_matrix.root_cause: Fast physical motion and subtle micro-expressions colliding within a single diffusion window.
troubleshooting_matrix.remedy: Split the shot into two cuts: render kinetic action as Shot A, cut to a 1-2 second close-up for facial performance as Shot B.

troubleshooting_matrix.root_cause: Previs lacks dark contact shadows or ambient occlusion under contact points.
troubleshooting_matrix.remedy: Enable SSAO and floor contact shadows in 3D viewport playblast. Diffusion models require dark contact edges to calculate friction.

production_math_formulas.shot_count: Total Film Duration (seconds) / Average Shot Length (3.5s)
production_math_formulas.estimated_generations: Shot Count * Average Iterations per Shot (4 to 6 takes)
production_math_formulas.previs_time_allocation: ~45 minutes per complex Type A shot
production_math_formulas.post_production_bandwidth: ~1.5 days per finished minute of film
